project_type: Kiroween 2026 hackathon monorepo: Python news pipeline (pipeline/), Vite+TS globe (frontend/), Rust->WASM core (rebellion-core/), AWS SAM infra (infra/template.yaml + infra/statemachine/rebellion.asl.json), shared contract (schema/)
language: Python 3.13 venv (target py312) for pipeline code and tests; YAML/JSON for infra; a POSIX shell script for Lambda packaging under infra/; Markdown for docs
build_system: No Python build step; SAM for infra (sam CLI NOT installed locally). Frontend and Rust are not changed by this task.
test_framework: pytest + hypothesis under pipeline/tests (test_agent_extract.py, test_binary.py, test_geolocate.py, test_pipeline.py, test_sources.py, test_stages.py, test_statemachine.py). Tests never call Bedrock, AWS, or the network: stub extractors (duck-typed .extract(article)), stub ready_check, InMemoryStorage / InMemoryTimeline, stub boto3 clients. test_statemachine.py loads the ASL JSON and the SAM template (PyYAML with a CFN tag loader, importorskip).

setup_instructions: Use the existing .venv (Python 3.13). strands, pydantic, boto3, botocore, pytest, hypothesis, ruff, black, PyYAML are installed. Run all commands from repo root /home/ssm-user/kiroween-2026-hackathon.
environment_constraints: No Rust toolchain, no sam, no cfn-lint. Local AWS credentials are INVALID (InvalidClientTokenId), so the real CLI preflight exits 2; use the stub path for fixtures. Network to RSS works but tests must not use it. Do not deploy, commit, or push. Everything is uncommitted in the working tree (previous task task-mandatory-agent-stepfunctions); do not discard or revert any of it. Do not change binary layout v2, schema/snapshot.schema.json, Rust sources, or frontend sources. Never add /.kiro to .gitignore. CLAUDE.md shows as deleted in git (pre-existing; its content lives in AGENTS.md); leave that as is.
contribution_requirements: Every artifact (code, comments, docs, identifiers, test names, log lines) in English. ruff (E,F,I,B,UP,S; line-length 100) and black (line-length 100). Keep runtimes separated: Python only in pipeline/. Narrative terminology per .kiro/steering/narrative-tone.md (Machine Strike, Witness, Ground Zero, Insurgency Report, Rebellion Timeline). Lazy imports of strands/pydantic/boto3 inside functions.
key_patterns: transform.py: RECENCY_WINDOW_DAYS (90 -> 30), DISCARD_THRESHOLD=0.20, ReportAborted, within_window (keeps published >= report_date - N days, future always kept, N<=0/None disables), filter_recent, fetch_articles, extract_one, assemble(results, report_date), build_report, run(..., extractor=None, ready_check=None), write_artifacts, encode_json. extract.build_strike(article, dossier, idx, geo) seeds jitter with f'{idx}:{title}', so carried-over strikes must keep their stored lat/lon (only their id changes). extract.needs_agent(article) is False for fully curated rows. models.Strike.from_json / InsurgencyReport.from_json exist; Strike is a slots dataclass (use dataclasses.replace to renumber). stages.py: Storage protocol put/get, S3Storage (lazy boto3), InMemoryStorage (objects dict, get raises KeyError), DynamoTimeline (conditional put for 'aborted' rows, ConditionalCheckFailedException tolerated via getattr(exc,'response')), InMemoryTimeline (_keeps_published_row), _parse_article_key regex guard, publish to snapshots/{date}/ and snapshots/latest/ with CACHE_CONTROL. cli.main(argv, **run_kwargs) forwards kwargs to transform.run; exit 2 AgentUnavailable, exit 3 ReportAborted. sources.is_reportable_incident(title, summary) applied only in _emit (live RSS); deny list _NON_INCIDENT_TITLE_PATTERNS, _NEGATED_INCIDENT_PATTERNS, _INCIDENT_SIGNALS, _looks_like_cyber; items are dropped silently today. ASL: Preflight -> Fetch -> ExtractEach (Map) -> Assemble -> PublishedChoice ($.published false -> ReportAbortedFail). SAM: four functions with CodeUri ../ and BuildMethod python3.12; bucket policy grants CloudFront s3:GetObject on ${SnapshotBucket.Arn}/*. frontend/dist (uploaded to the bucket root) contains index.html, assets/, geo/, snapshots/. Frontend reads /snapshots/latest/snapshot.{bin,json} and already shows 'No machine strikes reported. For now.' when total is 0.
